==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I dreamed about a psychic and a ghost working together. The psychic is a news reporter and the ghost is a designer. The two dream of owning a tile business together.

The tile industry is corrupt, so the two have to work together to fix things. They both act as superheroes who investigate and expose corruption. Their methods are extremely brutal.

They have both killed many people. They justify their actions by saying that it is to help them fulfill their dream. They are just as bad if not worse than the people they kill.
